methodology.temporal_split: discovery entry days before 24 October; retrospective check 24 October, not independent prospective evidence
methodology.mature_cohort: entry at least 3 hours before latest saved board; pending remain pending
methodology.search: all singles/pairs/triples of coarse domains plus discovery quartile numeric singles and numeric/coarse pairs; duplicate row subsets removed
methodology.multiplicity: one-sided normal mean tests, BH across every distinct tested subset; approximate descriptive only
methodology.minimums: 25 discovery to test,40 to nominate; descriptive survivor >=50 total,>=30 discovery,>=20 check, positive trimmed/day/league exclusions; statistical survivor also >=7 days and positive check CI
